address: Sy no. 458, Yelagalahalli Village, Hobli, Mandikal, Peresandra, Karnataka 562104, India

reviews.author: Afshan Umm Ayzah
reviews.text:
Big Bay exceeded my expectations from start to finish! Everything is so well planned—from the spacious parking and clean washrooms to the beautiful kids' play area and the variety of restaurants. The entire place is clean, organized, and perfect for spending quality time with family.

A special mention to BigScoopes cafe—I absolutely loved their Boba Mocha Frappe! It was easily my favorite. I also tried their Masala Tea, and it was surprisingly amazing. I'm not even a tea lover, but that one sip won me over. It was rich, flavorful, and one of the best cups of tea I've ever had.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I can't wait to visit again to explore more of what Big Bay has to offer. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ritam Biswas
reviews.text: The Pitstop definitely is a great space for halting between long rides for quick bites or for complete meal munching options. Big F&B brand outlets are available here like KFC, Baskin Robbins, Burger King, Haldirams etc. However, during our visit we observed that most of the outlets were either closed or were getting renovated. Not sure if they are taking down the placeorn what, but I hope it's not the case. Being an avid and consistent rider me and my group would love to see this place thrive with quality fooding options.

reviews.author: alexjoyluke
reviews.text:
One of the best highway pitstops I have ever visited. I’ve seen similar pitstops on the Salem–Kochi highway, but this one is truly different. There are many food options available. We visited Kirtunga—the food was good, but the service was disappointing. On the other hand, Big Bay is absolutely beautiful and well managed.

You don’t feel like you’re on an Indian highway at all; the place gives European, Dubai, or US highway vibes. It is very well maintained, well architected, and aesthetically pleasing. The service is really good, there is plenty of parking space, and the washrooms are extremely clean and well maintained.

A must-stop place to relax and enjoy the vibe during a highway journey.

reviews.author: Devi Ch
reviews.text: Big Bay at Yelagalahalli Village is a neat highway pitstop with good facilities for travelers. The place is clean, organized, and provides quick service which is helpful for people on long drives. Parking space is sufficient and the environment feels safe and family-friendly. Food options are available with decent taste and hygiene. Washrooms are maintained better than many other stops along the highway, which makes it convenient for families. Overall, it is a reliable stop for a short break, refreshments, and a comfortable pause during your journey.

reviews.author: shashank murthy

I want share about a Sandal shop inside this Bay named “Kameleo” you can get your customised sandals, men women and unisex, budget friendly and comfortable soles. Do visit once.

reviews.author: Subhankar Dutta

reviews.author: ARNAV SINGH
reviews.text:
Big Bay Highway Pit Stop is a nice place to take a break during a bike ride. It’s a popular stop for riders coming from Bangalore, with plenty of parking and a relaxed atmosphere to unwind before continuing the journey.

There are multiple food outlets available, making it easy to grab a quick meal or coffee. Overall, it’s a decent pit stop for weekend bike rides from Bangalore and a convenient place to relax and refuel.

reviews.author: Anju S

Very nice and clean place to take a break during your drive.
Multiple options for food and food was also good. The best part the washrooms were also very clean.

reviews.author: Surbhi
reviews.text:
We recently visited Big Bay and it was an amazing experience, especially being in Bangalore where life is usually so crowded with a lot of traffic. The drive to the place itself was very enjoyable and relaxing.

The outlets there are really nice and there are many good food options to try. We had pizza, burgers, and ice cream, and everything tasted great. The overall vibe of the place is very lively and perfect for spending a good time with family or friends.

Overall, it’s a great place in Bangalore to relax, enjoy good food, and take a break from the usual city rush. Would definitely recommend visiting!

Parking space available.
Clean washrooms.

reviews.author: Riti Kumari
reviews.text: It’s located on the Bangalore–Hyderabad Highway, around 60 km from Yelahanka. There are several pit stops along the way with clean washrooms, as well as a small play area and a petrol bunk nearby. Although the  few shops are currently closed, there are plenty of food options available.

reviews.author: pmrajasekhar yadav
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful experience at Big Bay! The place was very clean, well-maintained, and had a great atmosphere. The food court was excellent, and everything was organized perfectly. The washrooms were very clean and well maintained, which made the experience even better.
They also have a huge car parking area, making it very convenient for travelers on the Hyderabad–Bangalore highway.
I also had the pleasure of meeting one of the supervisors, Janardhan. He explained everything about Big Bay and the food courts very clearly and was extremely friendly and professional. It was truly a pleasure meeting him.
Big Bay is definitely a must-visit place for anyone traveling on the Hyderabad–Bangalore highway. Highly recommended

reviews.author: N Vishnu
reviews.text: Well maintained break point in long drive with international brands and south indian cafes and gift shops , and finally Thanks for beautiful toilets

reviews.author: Gowtham Thangaraj
reviews.text:
Big Bay India is hands-down one of the most comprehensive and well-maintained highway pitstops I've ever visited. If you are a car traveler or biker needing a rest, this place is absolutely worth the stop.
The selection of dining options is incredible—having Starbucks, KFC, Burger King, and Empire all in one spot means there is something for everyone. Plus, the convenience of the JIO petrol pump right there makes it a one-stop shop for fuel, food, and rest.
What truly sets this pitstop apart are the amenities and cleanliness. The entire area is spotless, the lighting is excellent (great for pictures and selfies!), and the restrooms are incredibly well-maintained. The inclusion of a separate baby room is a huge win for families. There’s even a dedicated smoking area.
The only minor critique is that the service and taste at a few of the restaurants could be improved (though with so many options, you can easily find a good alternative!). Overall, the infrastructure and convenience are top-notch. Highly recommend making this your stop.

reviews.author: Jj
reviews.text: Not only a good place for pit stops and food. But amazing for organising events as well on a sunday morning. This sunday we had organised an event with around 30 cars and 40+ participants and everything was amazing and huge shout out to the management at big bay for helping us out. Very big thanks to Vijay as well for constant communication and catering to all of our needs. Definitely will be hosting more events here

reviews.author: Shreyasi Som
reviews.text: Very good place for a highway pitstop, very good ambiance with lots of different restaurants, washrooms are clean and parking is free of cost

reviews.author: Vineet Khanna
reviews.text: An excellent highway pitstop complex where you get multiple options to dine and enjoy some cool desers and juices.

reviews.author: Arun Kumar Singh
reviews.text: This is the best set-up or pitstop on highway, I have ever seen. This place gave me best relaxation or break after long drive on NH44. You can enjoy variety of food here from famous brands, for example Burger king, KFC, Haldiram's, Krutunga, Go-Pizza, Leons Burger, Idli Vada Tea/coffee  counters, Starbucks, Ajfan store for some useful items (water bottles/cold drinks), including eatables. Above all it provides nice ambience, something like European Style space. They have very big, and managed free parking space. If you are going towards Hyderabad, then it's worth a wait. From Bengaluru, the Cube stop comes first; however, now I would recommend this place over cube stop. There are some improvement areas as well- at Haldiram's you may not get full menu items. They should have an arrangement for Drinking water. This place looks better in the evenings.

Ample parking, clean toilets, tidy paths and ambience are the highlights of the place. Big Bay is worth a visit even if it is only to come here and back.

reviews.author: Anish Panjwani
reviews.text: Big Bay India Highway Pitstop is a gem for travelers! The ambiance is clean, vibrant, and welcoming, making it the perfect place to relax during a journey. Well known brands such as Halidiram, KFC, Starbucks, Kritunga, Burger king, etc. are available.The food is absolutely delicious, offering a mix of authentic Indian flavors and global options. Service is prompt, and the staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. Ample parking and clean restrooms add to the convenience. Whether you’re looking for a quick snack, a hearty meal, or just a refreshing break, this place has it all. Highly recommend making it your go-to stop!”

reviews.author: SRK NAIR
reviews.text: Hotel Empire is a popular South Indian chain known for both its budget-friendly accommodations and its iconic restaurants, especially in cities like Bangalore. The hotels are generally clean, centrally located, and offer decent service, making them a convenient choice for travelers on a budget. What really sets Empire apart, however, is its restaurant—famous for hearty non-vegetarian fare like shawarma, grilled chicken, and biryani, often served late into the night. While many patrons enjoy the taste and convenience, some branches have received criticism for inconsistent service and hygiene. Overall, Hotel Empire is a reliable option for a quick stay and satisfying meal, especially for night owls and meat lovers.

reviews.author: Niharika Ganesh
reviews.text:
Big Bay on NH 44 between Bangalore and Hyderabad offers a well-rounded pit stop experience. The variety of dining options caters to different tastes and dietary preferences, ensuring that every traveler finds something they enjoy. The clean facilities and additional amenities enhance the comfort of the stop, making it a perfect place to take a break during your journey.

For travelers needing to pick up essentials or snacks for the road, the convenience stores here are well-stocked.

Parking: Ample parking space is available, making it convenient for those traveling by car or bus.

The cleanliness and maintenance of the restrooms at the Big bay are commendable, which is a crucial factor for long-distance travelers.

Restaurants: Empire, Starbucks, KFC, BR, Burgers king, Haldiram’s and many more.

reviews.author: subhashakti mishra
reviews.text: Big Bay is a well-designed, well-equipped highway food plaza offering a wide variety of food and essential services. Perfect for families and travelers needing a comfortable and convenient break—just not the place for a quiet, romantic evening. If you’re planning an anniversary celebration, you might consider pairing it with a stopover lunch at Big Bay, followed by dinner at a restaurant within Bangalore city for a nicer setting.

reviews.author: Prithviraj Koley

Nestled on the Bangalore-Hyderabad Highway, Big Bay India is a traveler's delight. With its pristine infrastructure and attentive service, it's the ideal pit stop. Whether it's a quick coffee or a leisurely meal, the quality is unmatched. A visit here is not just a break in your journey, but a highlight of it. Big Bay India sets the bar high for highway stops.

reviews.author: Pranurish Zone
reviews.text:
Fantastic Highway Stop Near Chikkaballapur on the Bangalore-Hyderabad Route
This highway stop features numerous well-known brand outlets, including Empire, Starbucks, Haldiram's, KFC, Frozen Bottle, and Burger King, with more brands set to open soon. A spacious lobby is available for those looking to unwind for a bit. The food across all restaurants are good and the washrooms are kept in excellent condition. We also noticed some gift and saree shops.  The restrooms are hygienic and well-maintained, and ample parking space is provided.

reviews.author: Rehan Akhtar
reviews.text:
Awesome place. Must visit if you like long drives and good food. We have multiple options veg, non veg, coffee, ice cream, etc ...

Big Bay is a popular highway pitstop located on NH44, the Bangalore-Hyderabad highway. It's a great place to take a break during your journey, offering a variety of amenities and services.

Dining Options: You'll find a range of restaurants and cafes, including popular chains and local eateries

Facilities: The pitstop is equipped with clean restrooms, ample parking space, and areas to sit and relax.

Shopping: There are several stores where you can shop for snacks, souvenirs, and other travel essentials

Kid-Friendly: It has facilities like ice cream parlors and play areas to keep children entertained

It's an ideal spot to refresh and recharge before continuing your journey.

reviews.author: Kullay
reviews.text: Big Bay India offers an amazing dining experience! 🤩 The food was absolutely delicious, deserving a perfect score. 😋 The ambiance was fantastic, creating a wonderful atmosphere. Service was good too, making it a great visit overall. ✨ I'd definitely recommend it! 👍

reviews.author: Ruchika Gupta
reviews.text:
Stopped by at this place on the way back from
adiyogi. The place is beautiful and neat . But it was raining so toilet floors were wet and messy . There are only 5-6 restaurants . We went to Haldiram, Leon’s and everywhere they had very militia food availability from the menu . Even Starbucks had only 4/5 items . I wish the food court restaurants are better stocked otherwise it defeats the purpose of being an highway food court stop .

reviews.author: Kiran Gopinath

reviews.author: Saranya Prabhu
reviews.text:
Big Bay NH44 is amazing! It's the biggest food mall I've ever seen on the highway! When you're driving and need a break, this place has everything you need. It's like a mini-town under one roof!

The place is huge, like seriously huge - 200,000 square feet huge! And it's super clean, like sparkling clean. You could even take Insta-worthy pics here!

But the best part? The food! They've got all kinds of yummy food - burgers, shakes, you name it. And the restrooms? They're air-conditioned! How cool is that?

Oh, and don't worry about parking - there's plenty of space for your car. Plus, they're putting in charging stations for electric cars soon!

If you're driving on NH44, you gotta stop by Big Bay. Trust me, it's worth it!

reviews.author: Nash A
reviews.text: The place is like an Oasis for travellers. Approximately 80km drive from Bangalore, this place has a good selection of stores and restaurants to help refuel for the journey ahead. The road merges into the place however currently it is a bit gravel road of sorts.

reviews.author: Thasleem P
reviews.text:

The place is clean and well-maintained, with plenty of parking. Washrooms are perfect and very clean, which is a big plus during highway travel.

reviews.author: TheExplorer

reviews.author: Shiv Chuni
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience at this petrol pump with a fantastic range of restaurant options and top-notch washroom facilities.

The variety of restaurant choices in this food court made it easy to find something for each one of us in a group of 4, and the overall atmosphere was very hygienic, extremely aesthetically appealing and welcoming.

We had an assortment of food from Haldirams, KFC, Burger King, Starbucks  and Empire. I have traveled the length and breath of India and have seen very few if none matching this standard

The cleanliness and upkeep of the washrooms were impressive and best in class – akin more to 5 star hotels than petrol bunks on the highway,  providing a level of comfort and convenience not found at petrol stations/restaurants in India.

We also filled fuel here and the staff was very pleasant and courteous to deal with.

I highly recommend this to anyone passing by for fuel and food.

Wish there were more options like this on all highways. It would make life simpler.

reviews.author: Solomon Sujith
reviews.text:
Big Bay Highway Restaurant, located along NH 44,

- **Facilities**: Big Bay offers a wide range of facilities, including restrooms, drinking water, restaurants, and other outlets. It also has ample parking spaces and areas to sit
- **Food Options**: The food mall provides a variety of multi-cuisine options, including popular brands like Baskin Robbins and pizza
- **Ambiance**: The ambiance is generally pleasant, with clean and air-conditioned restrooms, kids' play areas, and a relaxing environment
- **Convenience**: Big Bay is designed to be a one-stop destination for all travel needs, offering services like EV charging stations, heavy vehicle service, and a fuel station.
- **Overall Experience**: Many travelers appreciate the convenience and variety of services offered at Big Bay, making it a
preferred choice for a highway break

If you're planning a trip along NH 44, Big Bay seems like a great place to take a break and recharge. Safe travels!

reviews.author: Rajeev Jha
reviews.text:
Place opened and many shops restaurants got closed too soon too

Doesn’t look great vibe this place very dull very quiet like boring quiet

reviews.author: Naresh Kareti
reviews.text: A must pitstop to relax on the highway. It has all major branded food courts like starbucks, kfc, burger king, ajfan, B&R, toys, Leon burgers etc.. All the good options at one place. Washrooms are super clean and hope they maintain the same way at all times. Dont forget to stop here of you are travelling on this highway.

reviews.author: Vidhya R
reviews.text:
Amazing food court right on the highway.  You have Haldirams, idlivadateacoffee for veg and other options.
Washrooms are extremely clean
Lots of spaces to chill
Plenty of parking space

reviews.author: Goutam V
reviews.text: A very nice stop for riders or travellers. Also a great place to chill during  solo ride from Bangalore. It has all the great food spots. Empire, Burger King, Haldirams, Baskin Robins etc. Ample Parking space available.

reviews.author: Channabasappa Sidhalingappa
reviews.text: In Big Bay, excellent veg. hotel must try IVTC restaurant for treditional food Ragi Roti fresh food. Good for health compared to now a days Deep Freez Food chain Food outlets...

reviews.author: Lydia Solomon
reviews.text: It's an upcoming place but it's done so well. Finally some international standard restrooms and eateries. Lots more shops to come which means it will get more crowded but a great pitstop on route Bangalore to Hyderabad. Would highly recommend going here.

reviews.author: Bibekananda Dash
reviews.text:
A much needed refresh point on Bangalore-Hyderabad highway.
Clean washrooms.
Food options - Burger King, Starbucks, Haldiram, Empire, Kritunga, KFC and many more…
Next to this there is also a Jio-BP Petrol pump.
If coming from Hyderabad to Bangalore, U-turn available at short distance.

reviews.author: Akhil Chowdary
reviews.text: Its has separate restaurants like Kritunga, Haldirams, IVTC, Burger King, KFC, Empire, startbucks etc, clean wash rooms, area is clean and neat

reviews.author: sanath kumar
reviews.text: A very good place on the highway NH 44 to take a stop, it has all the required facilities from restrooms, drinking water, restaurants and other outlets. It has good parking spaces, and places to sit and stretch.

reviews.author: Varna Prakash
reviews.text:
Embark on a journey like never before! Big Bay on NH 44 redefines highway breaks with a blend of convenience and comfort. India’s largest highway food mall, it's your one-stop destination for a pit stop.
- Experience a culinary journey with numerous restaurants offering diverse local and international cuisines.
- Conveniently refuel at our on-site fuel station.
- Enjoy the cleanliness of well-maintained restrooms.
- Find relaxation in our designated smoking zone.
- Let the kids play freely in their vibrant play area.
- Anticipate the upcoming EV  charging stations (currently under construction).
- Stay tuned for the grand opening of the Party Hall, adding a touch of celebration to your highway break! 🍽️

reviews.author: Tejaswi Shrivastava
reviews.text: Nice and clean food plaza off Chikballapur right on Bangalore - Hyderabad highway. Lots of food options along with clean & hygienic washrooms. Must visit to refresh and proceed on your journey either way.

reviews.author: Barnita De
reviews.text: We stopped by Big Bay on way back from Le Pakshi for lunch. The place is big, clean, well maintained and organised. There are several food options. We chose Kritunga. Loved the taste of the food. It wasn’t very crowded and that could be because it is recently opened. Once crowd picks up, parking space may turn out to be challenging. Highly recommended place for all travelling through that road

reviews.author: Pravin Varma
reviews.text:
A well laid out food arena by the side of Bengaluru Hyderabad National Highway with varied choices for all age group and taste buds viz. KFC, Haldiram, Empire, Baskin Robbins, Burger King, Starbucks, Leon, Go Pizza etc.
Lot many other good fast food/drink joints are also available.
Restrooms are kept very clean and tidy.
Lot many photo points.
Ample parking is available for four and two wheelers.
Jio petrol pump is next to Big Bay.
Overall a nice place to take a break with family and friends.

reviews.author: Ahilya Malhoutra
reviews.text: We planned a day out and chose to go for a long drive. What a perfect stop over at Big Bay. Big shoutout to Janardhan, who made our experience that much better from helping us park to guiding us on our way out. Super service across. We also additionally enjoyed our coffee break at Starbucks. Thank you.

reviews.author: Kaushik Sarma
reviews.text: An amazing pit stop for anyone traveling along the Hyderabad Expressway! However, the existing outlets need to maintain high standards and ensure their service doesn't fluctuate. A few outlets currently have serious issues with non-functioning air conditioning, which definitely falls short of the benchmarks they've set.

reviews.author: Usha Hanumanth
reviews.text: It has a very pleasant ambience, clean and well-maintained restrooms, and a good selection of restaurants. A great place to stop for food and restroom facilities.

reviews.author: Alisha Aizaz
reviews.text: It’s a medium large area, where there are fast food restaurants such as KFC, Leon Grill, Baskin Robbins, Empire, GoPizza, Haldirams, etc. We tired KFC. The food was average in KFC. We tried chicken popcorn, chicken popcorn rice bowl, peri peri fries medium, chicken popcorn large, and spicy mayo dip. The rice bowl was below average. Otherwise the other items were good. We couldn’t try any other restaurants due to lack of time. The pricing was high for the quantity. The place is good as outing and has parking space for both two wheelers and four wheelers.

reviews.author: Ajay Morla
reviews.text:
Very scenic view with plenty of options to eat and spend time.
It has spacious parking lot and very clean washrooms.
A nice place for people who want to have a quick bite at a hygienic place.
Will recommend the same for highway travellers.

reviews.author: Wonder Boy - Siddhant
reviews.text:
It’s recently opened food mall on Bangalore- Hyderabad highway with lots of eatery options like Starbucks,Haldirams, Burger King, KFC,Leons Ajfan and many more
50% of the shops are yet to occupy.
Good thing is earlier there was no good food option if you are visiting for a day outing to Lepakshi

reviews.author: Uttara P R
reviews.text:
This place is a very good rest stop on the Bangalore - Hyderabad highway after Chikballapura.

Big Bay has several restaurants serving a wide range of food from burgers, pizzas, rolls, Andra food, Chinese food, North India food.

Some of the restaurants are KFC, Go Pizza, Empire, Kritunga, Haldirams, Ajfan Dates and others.

The toilets are clean and well maintained. It's a highlight of the area.

reviews.author: Maverick Rajiv
reviews.text:
Most of the restaurants were closed when we bikers reached there around 7 in the morning, except Burger king. Even there the staff was less and delay in delivery of orders.

Otherwise it’s an amazing well planned place just that we mostly see overseas. Guess the name itself is inspired from there.

reviews.author: Ajay Arora
reviews.text: Excellent stopover place on the highway for food, restrooms, just a break or to spend some time. Very nearly maintained. Food options range from Haldiram, Leon and many more. Ample car parking space. Approach roads are not good/fully ready yet.

reviews.author: ranvir singh
reviews.text: I thought of visiting this place while going to Lepakshi. It is on the highway. I thought u would get a tasty but all the shops were not even open at 7 am. Available food items were very limited and not tasty. Ambience is very good. Car parking is available free of cost.

reviews.author: syedsaleh28
reviews.text: Amazing place for a pit stop. The set up is quite unique and refreshing with a lot of good eatery brands in one place. We may end up spending more time here 😉.

reviews.author: Soumen Bhattacharjee
reviews.text:
This is a refreshment zone beside the Bangalore-Hyderabad highway. It has few big brand restaurants like starbucks, burger king, empire, baskin robins etc. Also it has toy shop and few more small shops. It’s a well maintained and beautiful soothing place. Even restrooms are very clean. It looks amazing during evening with plenty of parking area. If you are going that way, you must stop and experience it. Also if you are looking for a drive destination from Bangalore, give this place a try.

Have a safe drive!
